info.title: JobHub Agent API
info.description: Private job management and append-only timeline. No outbound execution. Jobs and events require stable source keys. All requests require bearer auth. Times are RFC3339. Job lists and event lists use newest-record-ID-first keyset pagination. A new event increments its job version. Only check events advance last_checked_at, using the actual check occurrence time. Rotating the key and restarting revokes browser sessions.

Stats.description: Full-profile overview, independent of list filters or pagination. Active = applied/talking/interview; needs_you excludes hired/rejected/archived. Total includes archived. Profiles breakdown always includes both active profiles workspace-wide. Days cover the last 30 UTC dates, jobs by creation and events by occurrence.
